87:1: Glorify the name of your exalted Rabb.
87:3: And He who determined and guided.
87:4: He who brings forth the pasture.
87:6: We will make you recite, so you will not forget.
87:7: Except what Allah wills is an exception. Indeed, He knows what is open and what is hidden.
87:8: We will ease you to the easiest.
87:10: Whoever fears, he will take heed and reflect.
87:11: The most wretched will avoid it.
87:13: Then there he neither dies nor lives.
87:14: Certainly, whoever is purified and mentions the name of his Rabb and performs salah has succeeded.
87:15: And he mentioned the name of his Rabb and performed salah.
87:16: Rather, you prefer the worldly life.
87:17: And the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
87:18: Indeed, this is in the first scriptures.
87:19: In the scriptures that are in the scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
